business.source: Barthelmes et al. 2023, LogIKTram (Journal fuer Mobilitaet und Verkehr), Fig. 5: outbound parcels of firms, read off the figure and rounded

delivery_target_private.source: ParcelDemandScenarioGenerator notebook weekday shares; consistent with the Tuesday-Thursday delivery peak reported by CEP experts in Barthelmes et al. 2024 (KIT)
delivery_target_private.use: the private shipping profile is derived so that the expected private delivery profile reproduces these shares

weekend_split.source: assumption: fulfilment centres ship twice as much on Saturdays as on Sundays (not identifiable from delivery shares)

transit_days_default.unit: share delivered on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd delivery day after shipping
transit_days_default.source: assumption until the BNetzA/WIK/Spectos transit-time study value is checked

business_saturday_open.source: Barthelmes et al. 2024 (KIT): about one firm in five receives or ships goods on Saturdays
